prompt_suffix: Render this as an XMind-style mind map diagram, as simple as possible. Keep layout clean and minimal. Use font family preference: Open Sans, Clear Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, Segoe UI Emoji, SF Pro, sans-serif.

images.prompt: A state diagram illustrating a Markov chain with three states: "Studying (S)", "Procrastinating (P)", and "Sleeping (L)". Each state is represented by a circle. Arrows connect states, indicating possible transitions. Each arrow is labeled with its corresponding transition probability. For example, an arrow from S to S is labeled 0.7, from S to P is 0.2, from S to L is 0.1. Similarly for P and L states, showing all outgoing probabilities summing to 1 for each state.
